buyer_added_terms.text: ेेतताा ाारराा जजोोड़ड़ गगईई बबडड कक ववशशेषेष शशतत

1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address AGM, Ward-34, Valves/Stores, BHEL, Trichy-620014 . 3. Generic Registration / Empanelment Requirement: Contract shall be awarded to only such sellers , who are registered / empanelled / approved / enlisted with with BHEL, Trichy under material group CPFOF for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid opening date. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reasonable procedure.) 4. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 6. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): By supplier's QC at their works Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: By BHEL QC at Stores 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. BHEL reserves the right to consider/Not-consider the offers based on the adequacy and evaluation of documents submitted.

B. All Commercial terms are non- negotiable. Any document(s), in any form, submitted by t he seller in this bid, which is not relevant or not requested by the buyer, indicating any d eviation from commercial terms, will not be considered and the offer will be evaluated acc ordingly. C. The below necessary supporting documents shall be attached under the following headers for smoot h evaluation of the offers. 1. Filled-in, signed & sealed “Scope of Supply” format – Annexure-A 2. Filled-in, signed & sealed “Schedule of Deviation” format – Annexure-B 3. Documents/records required as per PQR – Annexure-C 4. Filled-in, signed & sealed “Conflict of Interest” format in bidder’s letter pad– Annexure-D 5. Declaration Format in bidder’s letter pad – Annexure-E 6. Filled-in, signed & sealed Confirmations to Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms & Conditio ns (ATC) 7. Applicable Annexures 1-7, 10, 11-14, in bidder’s letter pad, as per attached checklist 8. Endorsed applicable technical specifications (such as Drawing, TDC, Purchase Spec etc.,) 9. Valid QMS certificate such as ISO 9001 10. UDYAM Registration Certificate 11. signed & sealed GeM Bid Document E. On-site assessment: BHEL reserves the right to conduct an on-site/ remote assessment (if required) for evaluation of qualif ied bidder after due intimation. F. Intimation of changes: Supplier shall duly inform BHEL about any changes to already existing location, company’s constitutio n, ownership etc., and request BHEL along with applicable documents and/ or records for updating rec ords after due review and evaluation (if necessary) for continuation of enlistment status with BHEL. G. Validity of certificates: As vendor registration requires QMS certification as minimum, the vendor/ bidder must ensure that th eir certifications remain valid throughout the contract duration or until they cease being a PMD vendo r. Any changes, including renewals, loss of certifications, or modifications to qualifications, must be pr omptly notified to BHEL within 3 days, accompanied by the latest supporting documentation. H. Scheduled Delivery date: In general, the scheduled delivery date will be same in GeM contract and corresponding BHEL PO. Bey ond the scheduled delivery date, even if the delivery date in GeM contract is extended for reasons per taining to GeM portal, only the delivery date mentioned in BHEL PO will stand valid for all reasons incl uding calculation of LD, unless notified otherwise I. Collection of rejected items: Items rejected during receipt/ usage shall be collected by the supplier from time to time by producing applicable credit note at BHEL Stores. Subsequently, replacements for rejected items and quantities s hall be supplied. J. Invoice submission: i. As part of our strategy towards digital transformation, Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL

) has launched the Unified Supplier Portal: https://suvidha.bhel.in/suvidha/ ii. Suppliers can log in to the portal using their PAN number (please refer to the attached User M anual for guidance). Through this portal, you can submit digitally signed invoices along with other requisite documents, as specified in the purchase order, for each dispatch. iii. Effective immediately, all digitally signed invoices (bearing a valid Class 3 Digital Signature) a nd related documents must be uploaded on the portal for payment processing. Submission of har d copies of invoices is no longer required. Please note that the system will not accept invoices wit hout a valid Class 3 Digital Signature. iv. However, as usual, duplicate invoice for transporter, packing slip, and delivery challan must b e available with the transporter for gate entry into BHEL factory/stores premises. v. Also, original MTCs, test reports, and other relevant technical documents as specified in the p urchase order/tender must still be submitted in hard copy—either via courier or in person—befor e goods receipt, for quality clearance. vi. In case of any doubt, kindly write to usdc@bhel.in, with a copy marked to the undersigned. Important Note: "In respect of procurement of goods or services from Micro, Small and Medium enterprises (MSMEs ), the settlement of invoice shall be only through any of the TReDS platform (i.e., RXIL, Ml xchange, lnvoicemart, KReDX, C2FO), authorised by the Reserve Bank of India. Such MSME suppliers to sele ct their preferred TReDS platform before award of contract so that the data is captured in the Orde r /Contract database of the Unit. They also will have the option to change the TReDS platform from the drop down menu on SUVIDHA portal of BHEL, at the time of invoice submission. Wherever the Trade Receivable is accepted by BHEL, the same shall be validated by the Unit on th e respective TReDS platform selected by the supplier. The routing of invoices through the TReDS platform shall not be construed as mandating discounti ng of such invoices and the MSMEs supplier shall have the option to avail or not avail financing or d iscounting of its receivables on the TReDS platform. In case discounting is not availed by the supplier on TReDS, the trade receivables will be paid thro ugh TReDS as per the payment timelines indicated in the contract." . 8.
